values.note: A single roadside site (on Jones Mountain Road per the site name; the page's directions text repeats site 030's). Gravel back-in driveway (listed driveway length 190 ft, moderate grade), max vehicle length 45 ft.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880266&siteId=29361 ('Max Vehicle Length: 45', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Length: 190', 'Driveway Grade: Moderate'), read 2026-10-20

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/bald-eagle/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880266&siteId=29361 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed every stored value: no hookups/dump, single back-in site (031 Jones Mountain Road) with a 45-ft max vehicle length, open year round, reservation required on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no showers/water and the driveway details. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate. The page's Site Directions text ('located on Stony Run Road at Hairy John's Trail') is copied from site 030; the entry is pinned at the page's GPS fields.
flags: Phone: the entry has only the 888-PA-PARKS reservation line; the Bald Eagle State Forest district office is 570-922-3344 (DCNR camping page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/bald-eagle/camping).
